# ML DSA Composite signature verification test vectors.
# Source: https://github.com/lamps-wg/draft-composite-sigs/blob/main/src/testvectors.json
# Message: "The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog."
# Context: empty (no context string)

# --- ML-DSA-65-RSA3072-PKCS15-SHA512 ---
PublicKeyRaw = COMP_ML_DSA_65_RSA3072_PKCS15_SHA512:ML-DSA-65-RSA3072-PKCS15-SHA512:

# valid signature
Verify-Message-Public = ML-DSA-65-RSA3072-PKCS15-SHA512:COMP_ML_DSA_65_RSA3072_PKCS15_SHA512
Input = 54686520717569636B2062726F776E20666F78206A756D7073206F76657220746865206C617A7920646F672E
Output = 

# tampered signature (first byte bit-flipped)
Verify-Message-Public = ML-DSA-65-RSA3072-PKCS15-SHA512:COMP_ML_DSA_65_RSA3072_PKCS15_SHA512
Input = 54686520717569636B2062726F776E20666F78206A756D7073206F76657220746865206C617A7920646F672E
Output = 
Result = VERIFY_ERROR
